# Cook Islands Environment Data Portal

> > A comprehensive environmental data platform for the Cook Islands managed by SPREP, providing dashboards, datasets, and resources for environmental decision-making and conservation.

The Cook Islands Environment Data Portal serves as the central hub for environmental information, monitoring, and reporting for the Cook Islands. It aggregates data on biodiversity conservation, waste management, protected areas, and climate-related information to support government policy and international environmental commitments.

## Key Topics

- Cook Islands
- SPREP (Secretariat of the Pacific Regional Environment Programme)
- National Environment Service (NES)
- Biodiversity conservation
- Protected areas
- Waste management
- NBSAP (National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan)
- CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species)
- Environmental data
- Climate data
- Capacity building
- Rarotonga
- Palmerston Island
- GEF-7 ENUA Project
- Pacific region

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org): Homepage for Cook Islands Environment Data Portal by SPREP
- [About](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/about): About page describing the Cook Islands Environment Data Portal mission
- [News and Events](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/news-and-events): News and events hub for Cook Islands environmental updates

## Data Dashboards

- [Waste Audit - Cook Islands](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/data-dashboard/waste-audit-cook-islands): Waste audit dashboard for Cook Islands PacWastePlus project data
- [Terrestrial Protected Areas](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/data-dashboard/terrestrial-protected-areas): Dashboard showcasing Cook Islands terrestrial protected areas inventory

## Government Reports & Planning Documents

- [Cook Islands State of Environment Report 2018](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/resource/cook-islands-state-environment-report-2018): Cook Islands State of Environment Report 2018 government assessment
- [Te Kaveinga Nui National Sustainable Development Plan 2016-2020](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/dataset/te-kaveinga-nui-national-sustainable-development-plan-2016-2020): Te Kaveinga Nui national sustainable development plan 2016-2020
- [Cook Islands Report on Trade in Endangered Species 2022](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/dataset/cook-islands-report-trade-endangered-species-wild-fauna-and-flora-2022): CITES trade report for endangered species permits and wildlife exports 2022

## Biodiversity & Conservation Projects

- [NBSAP Workshop Reports 2024-2025](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/dataset/nbsap-workshop-reports-2024-2025): National Biodiversity Strategy workshop reports 2024-2025 for Cook Islands
- [Cook Islands GEF-7 Project ENUA Documents & Reports](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/dataset/cook-islands-gef-7-project-enua-documents-reports): GEF-7 ENUA project documents and quarterly reports from UNDP
- [Palmerston Rat Eradication 2023 - Field Team Updates](https://cookislands-data.sprep.org/dataset/palmerston-rat-eradication-2023-updates-field-team): Palmerston Island rat eradication 2023 field team updates and reports
